requirement.edition: Resolution MSC.385(94), adopted 21 Nov 2014; consolidated with MEPC.264(68), adopted 15 May 2015
requirement.normalizedRequirement: IF ice_origin = 'sea ice' AND winter_growth_count <= 1 AND 0.3 <= ice_thickness_m <= 2.0, THEN ice_type = 'first-year ice'.
requirement.requiredInputs: Ice origin, winter growth history, and measured thickness
requirement.source: International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code)
requirement.sourceText: First-year ice means sea ice of not more than one winter growth developing from young ice with thickness from 0.3 m to 2.0 m.
